Latest quarter Mar 2026: Good (sales +49% YoY, profit +50% YoY)
Promoters raised their stake by 1.4 pts in a year
risks: Not at record: quarterly profit, annual profit
Margins shrinking (10% to 8%) - record profit may be near peak
Working capital stretching - debtor days 92 to 92, inventory days 87 to 87 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Cost quality weak: margin shrinking or operating profit falling (costs 92% to 91% of sales)
Micro cap (Rs 116 Cr): thin trading, higher risk - keep the position small
Weak cash conversion: operating cash flow only 17% of 3-year profit
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

guidance: As unit 4 in Gujarat scales towards full operation and new capacity absorbs ﬁxed overheads, we expect operating leverage to work in our favor in future.
Our polymer division which is in Dobbaspet unit targeted to go live by 26-27 year.
capex: Second ﬁnance cost also increased from 47 lakhs from 28 lakhs of previous because of borrowings and fund expansion.
Third depreciation also rose from 144 lakh rose from 110 lakhs of previous which reﬂects a new assets we commissioned.
risks: Our backward integration and in house pressure sensitive adhesive and sealants developing polymer division is what let us compete in that import substitute opportunity along with protecting our own margins over time.
In short margin pressure this year is the cost of capacity we have built but not fully utilized.
focus: Third, we deepened the certiﬁcations of approvals, new product trial approvals from vendors which is institutional as a institutional suppliers most notably part one approved from Indian railways for our auto adhesie tap
I will keep this focused on the audit standalone numbers for FY26 with the comparatives.
